name: Start a game and control a falling piece
description: Verifies the player can start a round and interact with the falling blocks.
steps: Press Space to hard drop a piece
expected: The overlay disappears, the active piece responds to controls, and the score remains visible.

name: Pause and resume a game
description: Checks the pause control can pause and resume active play without resetting the score.
expected: The pause action stops piece movement and resume continues the current game.

name: Use touch controls on mobile
description: Checks that compact-screen controls let the player move, rotate, and drop pieces.
steps: Open Block Drop in a mobile viewport
Tap the left arrow, ROTATE, and DROP controls
expected: Touch controls are visible and each action updates the active game.

name: Restart a running game
description: Verifies restarting creates a fresh round and resets game statistics.
steps: Move or drop pieces to change the board
expected: A new active round begins with score zero, zero lines, level one, and a cleared board.

name: Navigate the game guide and privacy information
description: Verifies visitors can navigate to useful game instructions and find privacy and contact sections.
steps: Open Block Drop on a mobile viewport
Tap How to play in the navigation
expected: The page navigates to the matching sections and displays the guide, privacy policy, and contact section.
